name: Yuikawa Akari
source:
A faithfully calm University student.

A modern day University student. 20 years old.
The God of Time calls her the "Priestess of the Dragon God",
for she will summon him to the Shinto "Dragon King's Palace of the Eastern Sea".
She is heavily empathetic, but slightly anxious.
From time to time, she will reveal a look of absent-mindedness.
